notes.title: First Update on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have some huge News for everyone supporting this game with Steam Wishlists, following us on Twitter or subscribe to us on Youtube. Oh wait i meant X right its not called Twitter anymore... [Kind of] Anyways because this is our first Announcement on Steam first some info.

The Game consists of six Nights, 6 Sequences between Night and Day and 5-7 Days [Mornings] (depens on your Playthrough). At the moment of that one Night, one Sequence after the Night and the first part of the first day are finished. Soon a Steam-Gameshow is coming in October and a Halloween Event on the end of October into November at which Operator: Observation is attending to. That means that on the 9th of October a publicly aviable Demo is launched! We have spend the last Months building up the Game and bring it into a playable condition. The Playtesters and the rest of our Team helped me with that. We want to stay on that path and want to bring the first day into a similiar condition before it gets released on October 9th. We want to show you a playable and good Game that you can hopefully enjoy. If you want to stay tuned on the News about the game follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/STRGStudios]X[/url]. Should any of you are interested, in the near future a few Gameplay Teaser as well as the Trailer will drop on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCefDziUUWhoU905rfwD3k7g]Youtube Channel[/url]. And for anyone that wants to go even a step further and help us actively during developement you can help us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/StronggamingStudiosPatreon]Patreon[/url] with as little as 1 Dollar. We thank every single one of you either if you follow us on X, subcribe to us on Youtube, wishlist our game or even actively supporting us on Patreon. We will give our best to make this Game into a good and enjoyable experience and we are excited for everyone of you!

Thank you for everything.

Cheers
- Your Stronggaming Studios Team
